title: Stable influences of a parity function
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinates, and let $\\varepsilon,\\delta\\in\\mathbb R$ satisfy $\\varepsilon>0$ and $0<\\delta\\le 1$. If $|S|\\ge \\log(e/\\varepsilon)/\\delta$, then every coordinate has stable influence at noise parameter $1-\\delta$ at most $\\varepsilon$ for the real-valued parity function associated to $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite subset of the $n$ coordinates
